1.en: In the Name of God, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

2.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
2.tl: ALLAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA BI-RAH'MATIK AL-LATEE WASI‘AT KULLA SHAY
2.en: O God, I ask You by Your mercy, which “embraces all things” (7:156),

3.ar: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
3.tl: WA BI-QOOWATIKAL LATEE QAHARTA BIHAA KULLA SHAY
3.en: and by Your strength, through which You dominate all things,

4.en: and toward which all things are humble,

5.en: and before which all things are lowly;

6.ar: وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء
6.tl: WA BI-JABAROOTIKAL-LATEE GHALABTA BIHAA KULLA SHAY
6.en: and by Your invincibility through which You overwhelm all things,

7.ar: وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
7.tl: WA BI-‘IZZATIKAL-LATEE LAA YAQOOMU LAHAA SHAY
7.en: and by Your might, which nothing can resist;

8.en: and by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;

9.en: by Your force, which towers over all things;

10.ar: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
10.tl: WA BI-WAJHIKAL-BAAQEE BA‘DA FANAA-I KULLI SHAY
10.en: and by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things,

11.ar: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
11.tl: WA BI-ASMAAIKAL-LATEE MAL-AT ARKAANA KULLI SHAY
11.en: and by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;

12.en: and by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;
